static_traits.name: Li Yajing
static_traits.family_status: Lives with parents and a young sibling
static_traits.social_status: 社交方面因羞怯而难以建立新关系；家人支持但not yet充分理解其在公众演唱的Fear；求职面试与沟通受影响
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；此前not yet接受心理治疗或咨询
static_traits.language_features: 紧张但合作；表达清晰；能够自我Reflection；Positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: 极度羞怯与Self-doubt，尤其是在他人面前唱歌；决定参加才艺表演试镜后问题加重，经常想象负面结果（如被嘘下台），导致without法展示才华；在想到公众演唱或提及试镜时出现强烈Anxiety，尽管尝试在镜子前练习与深呼吸，Anxiety仍持续。
basic_info.core_demands: Realizes that the fear of singing in public is hindering the pursuit of opportunities and the enjoyment of the passion for singing; expects through counseling to overcome the fear, challenge the negative beliefs, and build confidence so as to sing freely in front of others.
growth_experiences: 长期以来在社交情境中表现出羞怯与Self-doubt，影响参加求职面试与有效沟通，结交新朋友困难；not yet曾接受心理治疗；家人支持但not yet充分理解其Fear，导致持续的孤立与Self-denial体验。

core_beliefs: I am not good enough，会上台出丑
do not人会讨厌我并羞辱我

special_situations.event: The approach or mention of a talent-show audition
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我在公众面前表现得not完美，就会被观众讨厌并嘘下台
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在镜子前反复练习、进行深呼吸以缓解Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will hate my singing and boo me off the stage

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我忘词或犯错，就会彻底丢脸、场面not可收拾
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避在他人面前演唱，推迟或not参加试镜
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will completely forget my lines; the situation will spiral out of control

special_situations.event: Job interviews or occasions requiring communicating with strangers
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我表达not够好，就说明我not适合Work、以后都会失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 避免参加面试，Reduced socializing接触
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会在面试中说not出话，让人觉得我很差

special_situations.event: Family encourages auditioning and offers support
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他们not完全理解我的Fear，说明我的问题without法被看见与接纳
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 淡化或negate鼓励的积极面，继续Self-doubt与犹豫
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们not理解我，这些鼓励not用

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen, recognized and affirmed (especially as a performer)
core_conflict.fear: 害怕在公众场合被羞辱、Being rejected、被嘲笑
defense_goal: 通过回避与Self-protection来降低被评判与被羞辱的风险

object_relations.self_representation: An individual longing to be understood and supported
object_relations.object_representation: 善意但not充分理解的鼓励者（家人）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about or facing situations needing others' evaluation, such as public singing, auditions, interviews
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向将内在的Self-denial与羞耻体验，解读为他人会憎恨或嘲笑自己（移情：将他人视为苛刻的评判者）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 在对话中频繁描绘最坏情景，用“如果……就会……”的假设性语句ReinforcementFear，语气犹疑，难以接触到当下事实证据。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被邀请识do not证据或考虑他人可能正向的反应时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Attributes own negative expectations to others' views, convinced others will dislike and ridicule oneself
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以肯定句陈述他人负面看法（如“他们就是会讨厌我”），忽略反证与not确定性，减少探究性的细节。

manifestations: 感觉家人虽支持但not yet充分理解其Fear
Anticipation观众会拒绝与嘲笑自己
Realizes she stepped out of her comfort zone to audition, but fear limits self-choice and action
outcomes: 以回避维持短期安全感但长期notFreedom

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Believes the audience will hate oneself and boo one off stage
在尚without证据的情况下确信他人会负面评价

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Overly cautious before public singing and interviews and chooses avoidance

positive_force: 家人总体支持（虽not yet完全理解）
Has passion and motivation for singing, willing to step out of the comfort zone to audition
Willing to seek help and highly cooperative (positive attitude)
Has some self-regulation attempts (mirror practice, deep breathing)
negative_force: 灾难化、读心术、预测not yet来、过度概括等认知偏差显著
极度羞怯与Self-doubt，倾向回避评价情境
Highly sensitive to others' negative evaluations, depends on external approval
Anxiety影响睡眠与进食，进而削弱功能与自信

target_behavior.behavior: Fear and avoidance of public singing
target_behavior.core_reason: 对他人负面评价的高度Fear与灾难化想象（被讨厌、被嘘下台），伴随Self-denial的核心信念
target_behavior.function: 逃避被评判与羞辱的潜在威胁，获得短期Anxiety缓解
target_behavior.consequence: 错失演出与发展机会，Persistent self-doubt与Anxiety worsened，Sleep and diet affected

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding social contact and job interviews
antecedent: Situations requiring interacting with strangers or attending interviews
target_behavior.core_reason: 过度概括与负性Anticipation（认为表达not佳即证明自己not适合Work）
target_behavior.function: 避免失败与尴尬，减少被negate的风险
target_behavior.consequence: 求职受阻、难以建立新关系，进一步ReinforcementSelf-doubt与社会Withdrawal
